text:
Maya: Heads-up — planning a lightweight phased launch for inference runtime tweak v0.9.3. Target window TOMORROW 14:00 UTC. Short checklist below. Ping if you can't make the window.

Sanjay: I'll own the deploy. Plan is to flip traffic via router flag. Ramp plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~30m with manual holds.

Liam: QA smoke harness ready. I'll run `scripts/smoke_check.sh` after each step. Passing criteria: p50 < 220ms, p95 < 700ms, error rate < 0.5%.

Eva: I'll watch metrics and traces. Set alerts: p95 latency > 1s OR error rate > 1% -> immediate rollback.

Dave: Rollback plan in place: canonical tag is `v0.9.2`. Rollback command: `deployctl rollback --to=v0.9.2`. I'll be on standby to execute if needed.

Jen: Can we split cohorts by region? My pick: start with EU (smallest traffic), then US-West, then US-East to minimize blast radius.

Maya: That sounds good. Final slice order: eu-west-1 @1%, us-west-2 @5%, us-east-1 @20%. Hold for 8 minutes at each step for heat checks.

Sanjay: I'll do manual holds and post `ok` to continue. If I don't ack within 8m, gate auto-rolls back.

ops-bot: [system] Canary gate created: gate_id=cg-2026-03-17-01. Auto-rollback enabled on threshold breach.

Eva: Quick smoke command I'll run:
```
./scripts/smoke_check.sh --endpoint /v1/generate --samples 50 --concurrency 5
```
I'll paste summary here after each stage.

Liam: Adding tracing header for sampled traces: set `x-debug:trace: 1` for 5% of test requests.

Maya: Owners recap: deploy owner @Sanjay, smoke owner @Liam, metrics watcher @Eva, rollback owner @Dave. Escalation path: if we hit unexpected errors, ping #eng-oncall and @Maya directly.

Sanjay: All set from my side. I'll start the rollout at 14:00 UTC.

Jen: I'll monitor customer-facing channels for any reports and relay. :eyes:

Maya: Thanks team — see you in the window.
